body: GHerbo is making it clear that despite speculation surrounding his future in music, he was NEVER actually planning to walk away from rap. The Chicago rapper appears to be putting the retirement talk to rest as he continues to focus on his music and what’s next in his career. Herbo has now given fans another reason to pay attention, previewing what appears to be a brand-new unreleased track that has the streets talking.
